pain.title: Things you will not hear from us

items.quote: The crew vanished after the deposit.
items.answer: A contract with a deadline, a schedule and staged payments. The last instalment only after handover.

items.quote: The date has slipped for the third time.
items.answer: We make everything ourselves — no waiting for a subcontractor to free up.

items.quote: The gate rusted after two winters.
items.answer: We work in aluminium. Sea air and salt have nothing to grip.

items.quote: The glass cracked and the railing worked loose.
items.answer: Certified toughened / laminated glass, with fixings sized for local loads.

why.title: Four things a cheaper crew will not give you

items.title: It does not rust. Ever.
items.desc: Aluminium instead of steel. Five winters by the sea leave no mark on it.

items.title: Welds that will not part
items.desc: Laser welding: accurate to tenths of a millimetre, with a seam you can barely see.

items.title: One process from start to finish
items.desc: We design, weld, powder-coat and install it ourselves.

items.title: An itemised estimate
items.desc: You see what you pay for — materials, labour and equipment listed separately.

steps.title: Enquiry

steps.title: Free measurement
steps.desc: We measure and check the ground and access.

steps.title: Quote and contract

faq.title: If something is missing here — call us

items.q: How much does a gate cost?
items.a: The price depends on the size, the infill and the automation. A sliding gate starts at PLN 12,000. We give the exact figure after a free measurement.

items.q: How much does a glass railing or canopy cost?
items.a: Glass railings start at PLN 6,000 and canopies at PLN 2,500 — the exact figure depends on the length, the type of glass and the fixing method. We give it after a free measurement.
Usually 3–5 weeks from measurement to installation, depending on the season and the scope of work.
Gdańsk, Gdynia, Sopot and the whole Pomeranian province.
Aluminium does not corrode, and by the sea that is a real problem. It needs no painting and it is lighter.

items.title: A contract with a deadline
items.desc: Scope, schedule and installation date in the contract.

items.title: Staged payments
items.desc: A deposit, a part on delivery, the rest on handover.

items.title: A written warranty
items.desc: 5 years on the structure and welds.

items.title: A registered company
items.desc: Full company details and tax number in the footer.
